items.title: 61531_Juan Tizol oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] When Bill Mitler was in charge of the books? ... [INTERVIEWEE] I don't know who was.

ctx.x: He left it to the manager. And Juan had been with Duke -- my gracious -- 12 or 13 years then.
Well, who was running the office then? Mitler? When Bill Mitler was in charge of the books?
No, Bill Mitler hasn't been in charge of the books for quite a while.
